# Wedding Frontend Skill

## When to Use
- Building or refactoring UI sections (hero, cover, event details, RSVP, guestbook).
- Applying the glassmorphism and typography system.
- Adding motion for section reveals and micro-interactions.

## Procedure
1. Load docs/3_UI_UX_Guidelines.md and follow palette, typography, spacing, and animation rules.
2. Ensure GPU-safe animations (transform/opacity only).
3. Use Tailwind classes consistent with the design system.

## Output
- Updated components in src/components and globals.css or tailwind.config.ts.
